data.description:
## Goal
Provide the evidence the LP-0MU1S617L002Q9PR audit requires to close AC1 and AC2; both are measurement / decision items rather than implementation.

## Scope
1. AC1: capture a 24 h post-change window proving no request returns the upstream 900-second queue-timeout error (requires the AC1 ceiling fixes to be deployed first). Instrument/verify via proxy logs (dispatch_first_byte_timeout, chain-hold exhaustion events, and client-reported queue-timeout errors).
2. AC2: produce a fresh dispatch_first_byte_ms breakdown for local-routed requests and recommend how to satisfy 'p99 < 60 s' — either a performance fix or an operator-approved re-scope (e.g. exclude cold full-prefill / slot-wait segments, or set a realistic 1-slot target). Post-deploy artifact (2026-10-12) shows median 8.0 s / p90 80.4 s with a 900 s ceiling tail; ~200 tok/s prompt eval makes large cold prefills inherently tens of seconds.

## Decision required (producer)
Re-scoping AC2 or asserting the 24 h window start/end for AC1.
data.title: AC1 24 h post-change measurement and AC2 first-byte target decision
